Name: Skulls of the Shogun
Description: 17-BIT's turn-based tactics game. Lead General Akamoto's army of fallen samurai across the afterlife, eating the skulls of the defeated to heal and grow stronger, haunting shrines to recruit monks, and fighting through five lands to take the Shogun's throne.

Achievements.Name: Out of Line
Achievements.Description: Complete the Shores of the Dead on Normal difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Victor of Victorious...Victory
Achievements.Description: Complete the Land of Eternal Blossoms on Normal difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Gum-Splattered Lock-Plucker
Achievements.Description: Complete the Land of Monsoon Meadows on Normal difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Sound of One Hand Applauding
Achievements.Description: Complete the Land of Golden Harvest on Normal difficulty.

Achievements.Name: A Shogun Is You!
Achievements.Description: Complete the Land of Frozen Fortunes on Normal difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Devil Inside
Achievements.Description: Power up your General to a Demon.

Achievements.Name: Were you using that?
Achievements.Description: Defeat an enemy Monk by haunting its Shrine.

Achievements.Name: Outfoxing Death
Achievements.Description: Bring back a fallen unit with a Demon Fox Monk's Revive spell.

Achievements.Name: Lightning Storm
Achievements.Description: Defeat 5 foes at once with a Salamander Monk's Lightning Storm spell.

Achievements.Name: Gone with the Wind
Achievements.Description: Knock 3 foes off a ledge at once with a Demon Crow Monk's Typhoon spell.

Achievements.Name: The Bone Collector
Achievements.Description: Earn 15 gold skulls.

Achievements.Name: Kingdom of the Golden Skull
Achievements.Description: Earn 30 gold skulls.

Achievements.Name: Out of Your Skull
Achievements.Description: Earn all gold skulls.

Achievements.Name: Kurokawa Would Be Proud
Achievements.Description: Break a Deadly Alliance in online multiplayer.

Achievements.Name: Web Master
Achievements.Description: Win an online multiplayer match.

Achievements.Name: Online Multi-Slayer
Achievements.Description: Win a 4-player online multiplayer match.

Achievements.Name: Team Player
Achievements.Description: Win a team deathmatch game with your teammate still alive.

Achievements.Name: Speed Kills
Achievements.Description: Win a multiplayer match with a 20-second-per-turn time limit.

Achievements.Name: Epic Win
Achievements.Description: Win an online match that lasts at least 30 rounds, defeating at least 30 enemies.

Achievements.Name: Speed of the Shogun
Achievements.Description: Complete every level such that your best times for all of them add up to less than 3 hours.
